name: Superconduct
title: Superconduct
text:
Superconduct does not apply Cryo to targets hit, and therefore cannot trigger further elemental reactions.
## Damage
Note that one target can only take 2 instances of Superconduct DMG every 0.5 seconds from the same attacker, as limited by the Damage Sequence. Additionally, multiple Superconduct reactions triggered on the same target within 0.1 seconds can only produce DMG once, regardless of the source.
## Environment
Superconduct can also occur in the environment when dealing Electro to water that was previously frozen by Cryo, shortening the frozen duration and causing the water underneath to be Electro-Charged. However, no AoE damage is dealt, nor does the Physical RES of any nearby enemies decrease. Superconduct will not occur when dealing Cryo to Electro-Charged water. However, using  on an Electro Crystal or  on a Mist Flower will also cause Superconduct and deal DMG to nearby enemies.
